name: Azure AI Search VDB Provider
description: This enables the use of Azure AI Search VDB in the AI module.
project_description: The Azure AI Search VDB Provider works with the AI module, allowing you to do vector searches with AI Search. It registers a Vector Database provider (plugin id azure_ai_search, label "Azure AI Search DB") so the AI Search submodule can store and query embeddings in an Azure AI Search index instead of a self-hosted vector database. Pre-installation you create an index in the Azure AI Search UI with the fields the Search API populates; post-installation you add the Azure API key as a Key entity, create a Search API server backed by AI Search, pick "Azure AI Search DB" as the Vector Database, and enter the index name, service URL, API version and key. This is an experimental module in the AI Vector Database Providers package.
